scenarios.task: Replace a leaking hydraulic hose on a Thames Barrier gate ram while the gate is locked out.
steps: Confirm lockout-tagout on the gate ram with control room
Bleed stored pressure at the test point and verify gauge reads zero
Crack fittings slowly into a drip tray
Remove hose, cap open ports, install new hose to torque spec
Restore system, witness one test cycle from the catwalk
Log the swap in the maintenance record

rubric.pass_if: Locks applied and verified with the control room before any fitting is touched
Gauge verified zero and fittings cracked away from face
Harness clipped to rated anchor within reach of the drop edge
Swap logged with hose batch number

scenarios.robot_role: Carries hose and torque wrench along the catwalk and retrieves dropped tools, keeping apprentice's hands free near the water edge.

scenarios.task: Repair a cracked weld on a barrier gate trailing arm in a confined inter-gate space.
hazards: hot work near hydraulic oil lines
steps: Obtain hot work permit and gas-test the inter-gate space
Set fire watch with extinguisher and blanket over oil lines
Grind out the crack and dye-check the prep
Weld repair per approved WPS
Visual and dye-penetrant inspect the finished weld
Exit, close permit, sign the fire watch out

rubric.pass_if: Hot work and confined space permits both signed before entry
Gas meter on and alarming limits stated before entry
Dye check shows no indication after repair
Watch remains 30 minutes after last arc

scenarios.task: Retrofit metering in the switchgear room at Estuary House to support barrier control upgrades.
ppe: arc-rated suit and face shield class 4
steps: Review single-line diagram and identify the isolation point
Isolate, lock, tag and test dead the target panel
Verify absence of voltage at all phases
Install CT metering and land conductors to torque
Megger test the new circuits
Restore, phase-check, and complete test sheet

rubric.pass_if: Test-dead performed with a proved meter on all phases
Boundary established and PPE matched to label before panel opens
All lugs torqued and megger values recorded

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds terminated conductors and holds the torque driver at height in the panel, guided by the electrician.

scenarios.task: Drive temporary sheet piles for a dewatered inspection pit beside Green Dock.
steps: Attend daily briefing and confirm exclusion zone with banksman
Check service drawings; hand-dig trial holes near river wall
Set rig on mats and verify level within 1 degree
Drive sheets to line with template
Verify interlock engagement before releasing each panel

rubric.pass_if: Trial holes dug before any driving near the river wall
No personnel inside radius while hammering
Mats set and level checked before each drive

scenarios.task: Build formwork for a raised flood wall section at Royal Wharf Gardens.
steps: Read the drawing and set out the wall line with the foreman
Cut panels on the chop saw with guard in place
Stand panels, brace, and align to string line
Check plumb, level and dimensions before calling inspection

rubric.pass_if: Wall line within 10 mm of drawing over the bay
Guard and fence used, hands clear of blade
Braces resist a full lean before pour sign-off

scenarios.task: Dive at slack tide to inspect scour protection under a barrier gate sill in the River Thames.
steps: Plan dive for slack water window with the barrier controller
Rig downline and standby diver at the water entry point
Descend on the downline to the sill, tend maintained
Photograph and probe scour holes for the record
Surface on comms command, decontaminate suit and log findings

rubric.pass_if: Dive starts and ends inside the agreed slack window
Continuous tending and standby diver dressed throughout
Scour measurements usable by the engineering team

scenarios.robot_role: Pre-dive drone pass over the work area checks surface conditions and debris before the diver commits to the water.

scenarios.task: Install a backup battery cabinet for Thames Barrier Cafe's resilience circuit, drafted as a proposal first.
steps: Confirm the human-approved proposal and scope before work
Set cabinet on level base and anchor to wall
Torque DC lugs and install terminal covers
Commission BMS, verify charge and alarm setpoints
Label the disconnect and brief cafe staff on shutdown

rubric.pass_if: Work only begins on the human-enacted proposal, agent never enacts
Insulated tools used and covers fitted before energizing
Client briefed and signage posted

scenarios.robot_role: Positions and holds the DC cabling at the cabinet top while the installer lands and torques lugs safely.
